senses.gloss: ch. same, to go down. Impf. יֵחוֹת, inf. מֵיחָת, מֵיחוּת, imper. חוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 15:5">Targ. Ex. XV, 5</cite>.
Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 26; a. fr.—[Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIX, 23 למִנְחֲתָא, some ed. למִנְחַתָּא, read: למְנַחֲתָא Pa.]—
<cite ref="Shabbat 41a:4">Sabb. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>כי נָחֵית</he> when one is going down (to bathe).
<cite ref="Shabbat 41a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כי קא נָחֲתֵי</he> when they were going down.
<cite ref="Megillah 25a:5">Meg. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא דנ׳ וכ׳</he> a man went down (to the praying desk) in the presence of &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 39a">B. Kam. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ לעומק וכ׳</he> goes down to the depth of the law; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 133a:2">B. Bath. 133ᵃ</cite> <he>נַחֲתָא לדיקלא</he> she seizes the palm-tree for her widowhood, v. <cite ref="J00597"><he>יָרַד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 47a:5">Yoma 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ונַחֲתֵיה וכ׳</he> and let him put down the pan; v. <he>חֲתֵי</he> I.
Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIX, 23 (v. supra; Y. I למַחְתָּא Af.).

senses.gloss: to put down, rest; to let come down.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:56">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56</cite> (h. text <he>הַצֵּג</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 49:23">Targ. Y. I Gen. XLIX, 23</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:5">Targ. O. ib. II, 5</cite>.
Targ. Ez. XXIII, 15; a. fr.—Part. pass. מַחַת (מָחֵית); f. מַתֲתָא; pl. מַחֲתִין; מַחֲתָן placed, resting, lying; inlaid.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 8:11">Targ. O. Gen. VIII, 11</cite> (ed. Vien. <he>נָחִית</he>; Y. <cite ref="M00880"><he>מְחִית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 24:1">Targ. Jer. XXIV, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:15">Targ. Esth. VIII, 15</cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. B’shall., p. 91ᵃ <he>והוא מַנְחֵית לכון</he> and he will take bread down out of the oven (cmp. <cite ref="T00243"><he>רָדָה</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Taanit 21b:15">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה מָחֵית גברי וכ׳</he> used to place men apart &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 101a:3">Sabb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>גוד אָחֵית וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00118"><he>נְגַד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 91b:4">Ned. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו מַחֲתָן תחלי וכ׳</he> cress was deposited there.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 69a:2">B. Bath. 69ᵃ</cite>, a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 39:1">Targ. Gen. XXXIX, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 31:17">Targ. Ez. XXXI, 17</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Peah XIII, 21ᵃ bot. <he>איתנחת מן ניכסוי</he> became poor, v. <cite ref="J00597"><he>יָרַד</he></cite>; Y. Keth. XI, 34ᵇ bot.
B. Bath. 129ᵃ אִנַּחֲתַת לן חדא, v. נוּחַ Ithpe.
